review_comments.body: args is passed to the proxy, I don't get your TODO.

Actually, it's something I didn't understand (which is why I marked it as a TODO):

The `close()` method is marked as:

```c
PyDoc_STRVAR(close_doc,
"close() -> raise GeneratorExit inside generator.")
```

so there is no expected arguments. However, it's marked as 

```c
"close", anextawaitable_close, METH_VARARGS, close_doc
```

So, I wondered why we had `METH_VARARGS` instead of `METH_NOARGS`. But I don't know if we can safely change it to `METH_NOARGS`.

You should elaborate the TODO note in this case.

I guess that it's a proxy and so just pass tranparently arguments to the close() method of the wrapped object.
I've amended the TODO note and will address it later (or maybe @kumaraditya303 has some idea here)
IMO it's just the docstring which is wrong, it should be `close(*args)`.
I'll remove the TODO and will rebase https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/131671 on main later.
